Q: Can someone explain me why is this C program compiling without errors? A:

foo is declared as a function local to main function

Not true. It declares but does not define that a function foo exists, and that it takes an unknown number of arguments and returns a struct date.

This declaration is compatible with the actual definition of foo, as the return types match and the declaration makes no statement about the arguments.

Q: Gradle multi-module can't compile because class file for `javafx.stage.Stage` is not found A:

With the help of Stack Overflow AI Assist I was able to solve the problem.
While I thought adding and requiring just the javafx.graphics module would be enough, it wasn't!

Even though Stage is defined in the javafx.graphics module, real apps (and the JavaFX launcher/FXML) commonly require other modules (most notably javafx.controls) to be present on the module-path at compile and run time. Putting those modules on the module-path (and declaring the matching requires in your module-info.java) fixes the missing-class error.
